hypotheses.title: Autonomous Domestic Operating EBIT Revision Momentum (fnd2_ebitdm) (fundamental)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly eliminates the self-correlation bottleneck from Batch 165 Candidate 2 (which achieved Sharpe 1.91, Fitness 1.59, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.81, and Turnover 12.61%, but failed self-correlation due to the shared fn_oth_income_loss overlay). By replacing the external accrual overlay with an autonomous 60-day domestic operating yield revision momentum term (ts_delta(ts_backfill(fnd2_ebitdm, 60) / close, 60)) modeled on approved alpha 0c4d2fa0, the formula is 100% self-contained. Domestic EBIT isolates resilient domestic cash generation from foreign exchange distortions. Turnover is locked in the 12%-14% sweet spot, preserving Sharpe >= 1.80 and Fitness >= 1.55 while cutting self-correlation to <= 0.40.
confounders: Domestic economic recessions disproportionately affecting domestically focused firms
Cost-push inflation squeezing domestic margins faster than multinational exporters
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down if domestic operating earnings momentum fails to outperform broader market earnings over subsequent 20-day holding windows.

candidates.expression: 0.70 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(fnd2_ebitdm, 60) / close, 180), industry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_delta(ts_backfill(fnd2_ebitdm, 60) / close, 60), industry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, industry)
candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral 180-day rank of domestic operating EBIT with 60-day yield delta revision momentum and 5-day reversal overlay

hypotheses.title: Autonomous Forward Consensus Dividend Revision Momentum (anl4_afv4_div_median) (analyst4)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly eliminates the self-correlation bottleneck from Batch 165 Candidate 1 (which achieved Sharpe 1.82, Fitness 1.62, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.56, and Turnover 12.31%, but collided on self-correlation at 0.8642). In Batch 163, standalone anl4_afv4_div_median exhibited zero self-correlation warnings (0.00). By replacing the external accrual overlay with the autonomous 60-day dividend yield delta (ts_delta(ts_backfill(anl4_afv4_div_median, 60) / close, 60)), the alpha captures institutional dividend revision momentum without borrowing correlation from any other alpha in the portfolio. Turnover remains in the ~12%-14% sweet spot, driving Fitness >= 1.55 with near-zero self-correlation.
confounders: Broad macroeconomic interest rate shocks altering relative dividend attractiveness
Dividend cuts in highly leveraged cyclical equities
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms if upward dividend forecast revisions fail to generate positive price drift over 20-day holding windows.

hypotheses.title: Autonomous Forward Consensus Book-to-Price Revision Momentum (anl4_bvps_median) (analyst4)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly eliminates the self-correlation bottleneck from Batch 165 Candidate 3 (which achieved Sub-universe Sharpe 1.29 and Turnover 14.28%, but hit 0.736 self-correlation). In Batch 163, standalone anl4_bvps_median had zero self-correlation warnings (0.00). By substituting the external accrual overlay with the autonomous 60-day forward book value yield delta (ts_delta(ts_backfill(anl4_bvps_median, 60) / close, 60)), the alpha captures positive consensus equity growth revisions while decoupling from other value alphas. Turnover is disciplined at ~12%-14%, targeting Fitness >= 1.50 with self-correlation <= 0.40.
confounders: Unforeseen asset impairments not yet recognized in analyst book estimates
Disruptive technology shifts eroding historical tangible asset values
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if consensus book value upward revisions correlate with value traps rather than compounding businesses.
